findings.excerpt: Jon Baker began TEG 6 in Catalonia with the best gross round of his career, an 18-over 90 at PGA Catalunya's Tour Course.
Almost all of the good work came early, his front and back nines split by 13 shots.
Baker closed with three straight net gains at 16, 17 and 18 to take the TEG 6 Green Jacket lead from David Mullin
who had held it for 51 holes since the third hole of the tournament
